implementation.authority: existing committed source checkpoint, static binding, watermark and unexpired accepted evidence
implementation.queue_payload: bounded generation identity/header/receipt/binding/guard metadata only; no raw feeds or observation copies
implementation.dispatch_target: exclusive synthetic Redis tracking namespace, not client/mobile delivery
implementation.admission: explicit enqueue of configured source current committed generation; repeat after acceptance/restart to reconcile commit-to-enqueue gap
implementation.capacity: 8 total retained rows/source by default; owner range 1-32; terminal rows consume capacity; source count owner-controlled, no global operational quota
implementation.attempts: default 3, owner range 1-5; lease committed with incremented attempt before work
implementation.lease: default 10 seconds, owner range 1-60; random UUID token and attempt fence late workers
implementation.serialization: existing bounded source advisory lock spans validation/projection/ack; claims and ingestion share the same lock
implementation.retry: Redis failures use 1/2/4/8-second delays within finite attempts; SQL failure leaves committed lease for expiry/reclaim
implementation.superseded_generation: retire without projecting any historical checkpoint
implementation.corruption: source/evidence/job/checkpoint checks before projection and duplicate acknowledgement; fail closed
implementation.retention: original evidence deadline, expired-only physical deletion additionally checked against database statement_timestamp; explicit retain and admission cleanup
implementation.labels_and_service: simulation labels preserved; missing/stale GPS never implies cancellation
implementation.worker_grants: SELECT/INSERT/expired DELETE and operational state/attempt/due/token/lease column UPDATE only; binding/deadlines/source policy owner-only
